description: Source code for a documentation processing module, defining classes and functions for handling documentation structures, link patching, code group processing, and type parsing.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Manages a collection of classes, supports merging, filtering, link rendering, and code comment generation.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: Represents a documented class with members, properties, methods, events, and associated metadata.

classes.name: Member
classes.description: Represents a class member such as method, property, or event, with type info, args, and documentation.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents a data type, supports parsing from expressions, cloning, and filtering by language.

methods.name: mergeWith
methods.description: Merges current documentation with another, combining class lists.

methods.name: copyDocsFromSuperclasses
methods.description: Copies documentation from superclasses, appending members and checking overrides.

methods.name: filterForLanguage
methods.description: Filters classes and members based on target programming language.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes classes, members, and their components for quick lookup.

methods.name: setLinkRenderer
methods.description: Sets a custom link renderer and patches links in documentation nodes.

methods.name: renderLinksInNodes
methods.description: Replaces link placeholders in documentation nodes with actual links.

methods.name: renderLinksInText
methods.description: Replaces link placeholders in text with actual links.

methods.name: setCodeGroupsTransformer
methods.description: Sets a transformer for code group processing.

methods.name: generateSourceCodeComments
methods.description: Generates source code comments for all classes and members.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the documentation object.
